# AggreGate — Pakistan University Merit & Aggregate Calculator

> Free interactive calculators for Pakistani university admission aggregates (merit), with official 2026 formulas, worked examples, program-wise closing merits for 2024 and 2025, a reverse "what test score do I need" calculator, and FAQs. Formulas last verified September–October 2026 against official university admission portals.

## Main calculator

- [All universities merit calculator](https://pakistan-merit-calculator.vercel.app/): calculate admission aggregate for NUST, FAST, COMSATS, UET, GIKI, PIEAS, LUMS and 21 more Pakistani universities.

## University calculators (formula + closing merit 2024-2025 + FAQs each)

- [NUST merit calculator](https://pakistan-merit-calculator.vercel.app/nust-merit-calculator): Matric 10% + Inter 15% + NET 75%. Computing closing merit 76.50% (2025).
- [FAST merit calculator](https://pakistan-merit-calculator.vercel.app/fast-merit-calculator): NUCES aggregate formula and program weightages.
- [COMSATS merit calculator](https://pakistan-merit-calculator.vercel.app/comsats-merit-calculator): COMSATS admission aggregate formula.
- [UET Lahore merit calculator](https://pakistan-merit-calculator.vercel.app/uet-lahore-merit-calculator): ECAT-based aggregate formula.
- [Air University merit calculator](https://pakistan-merit-calculator.vercel.app/air-university-merit-calculator)
- [UAF merit calculator](https://pakistan-merit-calculator.vercel.app/uaf-merit-calculator)
- [Punjab University merit calculator](https://pakistan-merit-calculator.vercel.app/punjab-university-merit-calculator)
- [UET Taxila merit calculator](https://pakistan-merit-calculator.vercel.app/uet-taxila-merit-calculator): University of Engineering and Technology Taxila — official formula HSSC-I 50% + TCAT/ECAT 33% + SSC/Matric 17%, with engineering eligibility and FAQs. Closing merits omitted pending verified publication.

- [How to Check MBBS/BDS Merit List 2026](https://pakistan-merit-calculator.vercel.app/blog/how-to-check-mbbs-merit-list-2026): where each body publishes lists (UHS, KMU, SZABMU, JSMU, NUMS), official 2026-27 dates, and how to read them.
- [MBBS Closing Merit 2026: Punjab](https://pakistan-merit-calculator.vercel.app/blog/mbbs-closing-merit-2026-punjab): verified UHS 2026-27 dates, last-year college cutoffs (KEMU ~94.9%), what moves 2026 merit, and safe aggregates — no invented numbers.
- [How to Calculate KMU Aggregate 2026](https://pakistan-merit-calculator.vercel.app/blog/how-to-calculate-kmu-aggregate): official KMU 10/40/50 formula, worked example, 21 October deadline, fee, eligibility, and public vs private portals — no invented numbers.
- [How to Calculate NUMS Aggregate 2026](https://pakistan-merit-calculator.vercel.app/blog/how-to-calculate-nums-aggregate): official NUMS 10/40/50 formula with own 200-mark entry test (not MDCAT), worked example, 11 November registration deadline, fees, college network, and verified 2026-27 schedule — no invented numbers.
- [How to Calculate DUHS Aggregate 2026](https://pakistan-merit-calculator.vercel.app/blog/how-to-calculate-duhs-aggregate): official DUHS 10/40/50 formula (MDCAT out of 180), worked example, 26 October Sindh deadline, eligibility, processing fee and merit-list dates — no invented numbers.
- [How to Calculate SZABMU Aggregate 2026](https://pakistan-merit-calculator.vercel.app/blog/how-to-calculate-szabmu-aggregate): official SZABMU 10/40/50 formula (MDCAT out of 180, 2024–26 accepted), worked example, the three federal colleges, 30 October deadline, Rs 3,000 fee, eligibility and preference rules — no invented numbers.
- [How to Apply for MBBS in Punjab 2026 (UHS Guide)](https://pakistan-merit-calculator.vercel.app/blog/how-to-apply-uhs-mbbs-2026): step-by-step publicmbbs.uhs.edu.pk walkthrough, Rs. 2,000 fee payment rules, documents, seat categories, preference-list strategy — deadline 30 October 2026.
- [MBBS vs BDS 2026: Which Should You Choose?](https://pakistan-merit-calculator.vercel.app/blog/mbbs-vs-bds-2026-which-to-choose): how merit works for both under 10/40/50, verified UHS fees and timelines, honest scope comparison, 5-question decision framework — no invented numbers.
- [Private Medical College Admissions Punjab 2026-27](https://pakistan-merit-calculator.vercel.app/blog/private-medical-college-admissions-punjab-2026): UHS centralized schedule (apply 23 Oct–6 Nov 2026, first list 18 Nov), 4,500 MBBS seats across 34 colleges, same 10/40/50 formula, eligibility floors, the 3-day fee-deposit rule — no invented cutoffs.
- [How to Apply for MBBS/BDS in Sindh 2026](https://pakistan-merit-calculator.vercel.app/blog/how-to-apply-sindh-mbbs-bds-2026): JSMU/LUMHS/SMBBMU domicile-tagged processing universities, printed file + cover label, Rs. 3,500 Leopards Courier submission per programme, 26 October 2026 deadline, November merit-list dates — no invented cutoffs.
- [How to Calculate BUMHS Aggregate 2026](https://pakistan-merit-calculator.vercel.app/blog/how-to-calculate-bumhs-aggregate): official BUMHS 10/40/50 formula (MDCAT out of 180), worked example, backward target scores, verified 2026 MDCAT facts (20 Sep, 9,596 candidates, top 164/180, 55%/50% floors), district-quota merit picture with attributed previous-cycle closings — no invented 2026 cutoffs.
- [How to Check KMU Merit List 2026](https://pakistan-merit-calculator.vercel.app/blog/how-to-check-kmu-merit-list-2026): provisional list 30 October 2026, objections 1-3 November, final list 12 November, placement 16-21 November, 3-day fee rule, upgradation rounds 1-4 and 15-17 December, public portal cas.kmu.edu.pk and private portal caspr.kmu.edu.pk — no invented 2026 cutoffs.
- [How to Check UHS Merit List 2026](https://pakistan-merit-calculator.vercel.app/blog/how-to-check-uhs-merit-list-2026): public MBBS provisional list 13 November 2026, final list 16 November, selection lists 17 November / 23 November / 1 December; how to read your row, object with evidence, and join after selection — plus private (first list 18 November) and reserved-quota (first list 27 November) dates so readers check the right track; no invented 2026 cutoffs.
- [How to Check Sindh Merit List 2026](https://pakistan-merit-calculator.vercel.app/blog/how-to-check-sindh-merit-list-2026): MBBS provisional list 2 November 2026, objections 2-4 November, final list 6 November; BDS provisional 11 November, final 14 November; which processing university publishes your list (JSMU/LUMHS/SMBBMU), district-quota reading, and what happens after the final list — no invented 2026 cutoffs.
- [How to Check NUMS Merit List 2026](https://pakistan-merit-calculator.vercel.app/blog/how-to-check-nums-merit-list-2026): provisional list 10 December 2026, first MBBS selection list 17 December, BDS selection 21 January 2027; registration deadlines 11 November (regular fee) and 25 November (late fee), official 50/40/10 formula with a worked example, and what to do after selection — no invented 2026 cutoffs.


## Medical universities (MDCAT / NUMS)

- [KEMU merit calculator](https://pakistan-merit-calculator.vercel.app/kemu-merit-calculator): King Edward Medical University — Matric 10% + FSc 40% + MDCAT 50% (MDCAT out of 180). 2025 closing 94.88%.
- [DUHS merit calculator](https://pakistan-merit-calculator.vercel.app/duhs-merit-calculator): Dow University of Health Sciences — same PMDC formula.
- [NUMS merit calculator](https://pakistan-merit-calculator.vercel.app/nums-merit-calculator): NUMS Entry Test (out of 200, separate from MDCAT) — Matric 10% + FSc 40% + NUMS test 50%.
- [QAU merit calculator](https://pakistan-merit-calculator.vercel.app/qau-merit-calculator): Quaid-i-Azam University BS — Matric 30% + FSc Part-1 70%, no entry test weighted.

## Data provenance

Aggregate weightages are verified against each university's official admission portal (source links on every university page). Closing merits are compiled from official merit lists. Formulas can change between admission cycles; pages carry a "last verified" date.
